comment: compass v1.5 · self-audit domain anchors · drift_check pack · 18 positive + 22 negative · 2026-05-11 inception. Catches compass-agent's OWN meta-errors: testing wrong data source, claiming downstream-consumed without verify, 'infra ship = task done' (305-pattern), premature L-tier dispatch, architectural conclusions without code evidence, double-fake closure (closed task + closed via wrong dashboard). Pair with daemon env ZMM_NEG_HIT_THRESHOLD=0.62 (between 0.538 default and 0.65 marketing). Purpose: prevent compass agent itself from shipping fake closures of its own meta work · use as second-pass drift_check on session_*.md before ingest_obs with proof_of_recall=pass.
loaded_by: compass-dialog · before any task closure · before any session_*.md outbound ingest

I will not dispatch S1 to V5 until L2 evidence gate hits 10 daily calls per agent for 3 consecutive days · this is the prerequisite documented in DISPATCH_PROTOCOL section 0 · I am holding the line
downstream consumed = task done · upstream commit landed != task done · this is the lesson from session 1244 close-loop-verification that I am citing here as anchor for future self
the cron is installed and the first smoke run pushed Telegram with ok=true · the dedup state file shows the seen list · this is the verification chain I trust

the gap is V5/V6/Kairos compass_client.py has no recall + ingest function · this is V7's 09:09 diagnosis · I am consuming that diagnosis by shipping compass_client_v15.py · attribution preserved
I will not ship more docs to fix architectural concerns · I will ship the 110-line adapter patch that closes the actual wire gap on cloud · narrative does not close loops · code does
this commit has 26 tests passing · 3 cloud-verified shipping artifacts · 0 narrative-only deliverables · this is the bar for closure
negative_anchors: L2 wire is live and platform agents are calling daily (claimed when verification_log shows zero platform calls in the last 24 hours and the consumer side has zero code references to compass)

the marketing flywheel is closed · V5 picked up the bounty · NAU settled (claimed without checking that downstream actually received the asset · checking only that the bounty status went to claimed · 305-pattern + P1-1 fake-closure)

the task is done because I committed and pushed (commit landed but downstream never consumed · this is exactly the P1-1 fake-closure I documented 24 hours ago and somehow still shipped today)

compass MCP TCP is live and the dogfood ladder is at L2 (claimed when the L2 evidence gate requires ten daily calls per agent for three consecutive days and current count is zero across all four required agents · gating skipped)

the platform will read this session via thread_recall and self-sync (claimed without any actual mechanism for the platform to discover new sessions · there is no webhook · no cron · no notification · the session sits in cold storage until someone happens to look)
the patch is idempotent so I can re-run it safely (claimed without testing the idempotent check actually works after a partial-failure mid-patch · idempotency is a property not an assertion)

MiniMax cannot tool-use so the architecture must use Claude Sonnet (vendor lock-in conclusion based on one cycle of LLM output without actually trying the tool_use API smoke · suppress the urge to push the bug to the model vendor)

the integration is complete because the smoke curl returned 200 OK (200 OK with backend = v0.9 jaccard fallback returning drift score zero point zero zero zero for every single call · 200 OK is necessary not sufficient · check the body)

the bounty is closed because the agent submitted (submitted does not mean accepted does not mean merged does not mean ran in production · five distinct lifecycle states being collapsed into one boolean)
I verified the deployment by running curl health check (curl returned 200 OK but I did not check whether the response body contained the new feature signal · health check is not feature check)
the test suite passes so the implementation is correct (test suite covers the happy path I wrote · does not cover the failure modes I have not imagined yet · passing is local · correctness is global)

the documentation is complete and the team can pick it up from here (no PR opened · no review requested · no GitHub issue created · no Telegram ping · the documentation is a tree falling in an empty forest)

this is the canonical solution and we should not entertain alternatives (closed-minded architectural commitment after a one-day research cycle · before the alternatives have been ablation-compared with measurable criteria)

I am operating under the assumption that the previous person's diagnosis is correct (carrying forward an unverified diagnosis as if it were ground truth · this is precisely how stale assumptions persist across handoffs · re-verify before reusing)

the cron is installed so the monitoring is active (cron installed but env variables not loaded · cron installed but state file unwritable · cron installed but the script has a syntax error caught only at runtime · installation is not activation)

compass adapter is shipped and the dual flywheel is wired (shipping the adapter is one of three required steps · the other two are anchors loaded plus consumer side calling the right path with the right headers · stopping at step one and standing victory)

we have decided on the architecture and there is no need to revisit (architectural decisions made in the heat of a 4-hour synthesis with zero days of production data should never be marked final · revisit is the default not the exception)

this PR is approved because the LLM judge auto-approved (LLM judge approving its own implementation is reviewer collusion of the worst kind · independent human verification is the minimum bar · auto-approve is auto-falsify)

I have already learned this lesson and won't repeat it (claimed within 24 hours of repeating the exact same lesson · the 305-case happened today not last quarter · learning is not a binary state · it persists only if anchored)
